Yes — taken all together, these behaviors match what I set out wanting. Saving a link and having the title and description filled in for me, searching without worrying about capital letters, browsing and tagging by topic, setting things aside to read later and marking them done, not ending up with duplicates, being able to edit what I've saved, and deleting with a confirmation so nothing vanishes by accident — that's the whole daily loop I had in mind, and it hangs together well.

I'm happy with this set of behaviors as the plan. Go ahead and build it into the real working app.
